outcome: number of packed red blood cells or fresh frozen plasma transfused
postoperative complications (intrauterine hematocele, intrauterine infection, surgical site infection, deep tissue infection)
cohort: The study included 92 patients undergoing surgical termination of second-trimester pregnancies complicated by placenta previa and placenta accreta spectrum following prior cesarean delivery.
finding: Prophylactic uterine artery embolization was associated with increased febrile morbidity and prolonged recovery, without significantly reducing blood loss or hysterectomy rates in second-trimester pregnancy terminations with placenta previa and accreta spectrum and prior cesarean delivery.
